description: Look up a vacation rental by its RentalCal booking site, or by the page on the host's own website where their RentalCal booking widget is installed. Accepts a site address such as beach-house.rentalcal.com, a full URL, the bare site name, or the host's own domain. Returns the listing: description, location, capacity, amenities, house rules, photos, nightly pricing, cancellation policy, payment schedule, damage deposit, the host's FAQ, and the property id. When one website hosts several properties, returns those candidates instead.

site.description: The booking site's address or URL, e.g. beach-house.rentalcal.com, or the address of the host's own page with the booking widget on it.

name: find_property
title: Find a RentalCal property
